title: CodeChef: Far Away (Max Manhattan Distance)
description: Chef has an array `a` of `n` integers where 1 <= a[i] <= m. He chooses an array `b` with 1 <= b[i] <= m to maximize the total distance sum |a[i] - b[i]|. Return maximum distance.
starter_code:
def max_far_away(m: int, a: list[int]) -> int:
    pass
solution:
def max_far_away(m: int, a: list[int]) -> int:
    return sum(max(abs(x - 1), abs(x - m)) for x in a)
explanation: Greedy choice: for each item, maximum difference occurs at boundary 1 or m.
